title: Broken Daily ETL Pipeline
problem: A daily batch job fails because source schema added a new nullable column and downstream transform crashes.
solution: Add schema validation at ingestion, support permissive mode for unknown nullable columns, and enforce contract checks before transform. Alert on schema drift and version your downstream models.

title: Late Arriving Events in Streaming
problem: Kafka events arrive late and dashboard numbers keep changing every refresh.
hint: Use event time, watermark, and upsert strategy.
solution: Process with event-time windows and watermark (e.g., 15 minutes). Store aggregates in mergeable tables (Delta/Iceberg) and perform idempotent upserts for late events.

title: Warehouse Cost Explosion
problem: Monthly warehouse cost doubled after new dashboards launched.
hint: Profile query patterns and optimize table design.
solution: Introduce partitioning/clustering on common filters, materialize high-usage aggregates, add query limits for BI users, and monitor expensive queries with alerts.

title: PII Compliance in Data Lake
problem: Raw zone contains PII fields consumed by too many teams.
solution: Implement column-level masking/tokenization, role-based policies, and curated gold views with only required attributes. Audit data access and add retention rules.
